description: Single-factor class-weight ablation versus exp_004_train_norm (power 1) and exp_006_sqrt_weights (power 0.5): use (N_train/(4*n_train_class))**0.75 from frozen TRAIN window counts. Retain Adam LR=0.001, TRAIN-only scalar z-score, eight frozen model/frontend pairs, split, caches, selection and loss-based stopping. Validation-only; TEST disabled. Weighted loss values are not comparable across policies.
